new.brief: Creates a new `GtkCssSection` referring to the section in the given `file` from the `start` location to the `end` location.
new.md:
Creates a new `GtkCssSection` referring to the section
in the given `file` from the `start` location to the
`end` location.

new_with_bytes.brief: Creates a new `GtkCssSection` referring to the section in the given `file` or the given `bytes` from the `start` location to the `end` location.
new_with_bytes.md:
Creates a new `GtkCssSection` referring to the section
in the given `file` or the given `bytes` from the `start` location to the
`end` location.

doc.brief: Defines a part of a CSS document.
doc.md:
Defines a part of a CSS document.

Because sections are nested into one another, you can use
[`CssSection.get_parent()`](xref:gtk:CssSection#method:get_parent) to get the containing region.

get_bytes.brief: Gets the bytes that `section` was parsed from.
get_bytes.md: Gets the bytes that `section` was parsed from.

get_end_location.brief: Returns the location in the CSS document where this section ends.
get_end_location.md: Returns the location in the CSS document where this section ends.

get_file.brief: Gets the file that `section` was parsed from.
get_file.md:
Gets the file that `section` was parsed from.

If no such file exists, for example because the CSS was loaded via
[`CssProvider.load_from_data()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssProvider#method:load_from_data), then `NULL` is returned.

get_parent.brief: Gets the parent section for the given `section`.
get_parent.md:
Gets the parent section for the given `section`.

The parent section is the section that contains this `section`. A special
case are sections of  type `GTK_CSS_SECTION_DOCUMENT`. Their parent will
either be `NULL` if they are the original CSS document that was loaded by
[`CssProvider.load_from_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssProvider#method:load_from_file) or a section of type
`GTK_CSS_SECTION_IMPORT` if it was loaded with an `@import` rule from
a different file.

get_start_location.brief: Returns the location in the CSS document where this section starts.
get_start_location.md: Returns the location in the CSS document where this section starts.

print.brief: Prints the `section` into `string` in a human-readable form.
print.md:
Prints the `section` into `string` in a human-readable form.

This is a form like `gtk.css:32:1-23` to denote line 32, characters
1 to 23 in the file `gtk.css`.

to_string.brief: Prints the section into a human-readable text form using [`CssSection.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssSection#method:print).
to_string.md:
Prints the section into a human-readable text form using
[`CssSection.print()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CssSection#method:print).

unref.brief: Decrements the reference count on `section`, freeing the structure if the reference count reaches 0.
unref.md:
Decrements the reference count on `section`, freeing the
structure if the reference count reaches 0.
